name: Shubham Raj
headline: Senior Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend engineer with 6+ years of professional software experience across banking, payments, and enterprise products. I build thoughtful interfaces with React, TypeScript, and Next.js, connecting reusable architecture with performance, accessibility, and clear user journeys. Currently a Senior Associate Consultant at Infosys, supporting Visa in Mexico City.

roles.title: Senior Associate Consultant
roles.summary: Enterprise frontend engineering across payments and banking.
bullets: Contribute to Visa enterprise products in a shared monorepo using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend architecture; coordinate changes across projects and teams.
Delivered 20+ interactive features for Citi using React, TypeScript, and Next.js, including dashboard graphs and data visualizations.
Reduced unnecessary re-renders by 35% and improved page load performance by 40% through state optimization, code splitting, and lazy loading on the Citi engagement.
Mentored 3 junior developers and collaborated with product owners, QA, and DevOps to support 90% on-time delivery in two-week sprints.
Review code, assess dependencies and vulnerabilities, and develop proofs of concept; use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot with engineering review and validation.

roles.title: Consultant
roles.summary: Reusable banking interfaces, faster loads, and stronger release quality.
bullets: Designed and delivered 50+ user-facing features with React, Redux, TypeScript, Vite, and Material UI for financial services applications.
Refactored 30+ components and improved loading performance by 35% through API optimization and more efficient state management.
Tested and optimized 140+ components for cross-browser compatibility; used Jest and React Testing Library for regression coverage.
Collaborated with backend, design, product, and QA teams; contributed code reviews, ESLint and SonarQube checks, and CI/CD configuration.

roles.title: Solution Engineer
roles.summary: Data-driven applications, from reusable UI to deployment.
bullets: Built data-driven applications with React and Next.js, including responsive components and server-side rendering.
Integrated REST APIs with authentication and validation, and supported cloud deployments and critical-feature testing.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.summary: An early foundation in testing, automation, and product reliability.
bullets: Authored 350+ JavaScript tests and integrated automation into Jenkins build pipelines.
Performed UI regression and device testing, coordinated with development teams, and documented test plans and execution results.
